- **Sett_Rot**: Affects planting setts/roots — not relevant
- **Streak_Mosaic_Scsmv**: Shows fine chlorotic streaks, but more of a mosaic/streaked pattern across the blade

- **Yellow_Leaf**: Shows midrib yellowing — not matching; no yellow coloration
- **Yellow_Spot**: Would show discrete yellow spots — not present

The single broad white/pale band running longitudinally along the leaf veins is the hallmark of **Leaf Scald**, where pencil-thin white stripes coalesce into broader bleached areas.
